expectedRealization.rationale: Tariff-market reform and fuel-cost normalization can repair thermal-power earnings over one to two reporting cycles.

changeHypothesis.summary: October reform widened coal-fired tariff flexibility while coal-price intervention reduced input-cost pressure, creating a genuine normalized-earnings repair path for thermal power. 华能 had the largest structural upside to a tariff/fuel-spread reset, but Q3 still showed a large loss, the stock had already rerated dramatically over 60d, and contemporaneous 2022E valuation was materially richer than 华电.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: The tariff mechanism is regulatory and multi-quarter; coal-price normalization can improve cash generation beyond a one-month commodity move.
disconfirmingEvidence: Q3 attributable loss RMB3.499bn and YTD profit -91.42%.
华能 60d benchmark-relative return remained about +125pp at Nov1 while 20d had already turned negative.
Dec26 consensus showed 2022E PE ~21.9x for 华能 versus ~6.5x for 华电.

causalChain.mechanism: Higher allowed power transaction prices and constrained coal prices improve revenue-cost pass-through.
causalChain.failureMode: coal prices stay high or tariff uplift is insufficient

causalChain.mechanism: Large coal-fired fleet provides high operating leverage when fuel-price and tariff spread normalizes.
causalChain.failureMode: fuel costs overwhelm power-price gains or losses persist

causalChain.mechanism: Alpha requires recovery not already capitalized by the prior rerating and must compare favorably with cheaper power peers.
causalChain.failureMode: recovery is already priced or peers offer better recovery/valuation

directWinners: thermal generators with tariff/fuel spread repair
secondOrderWinners: renewable-transition utilities funded by restored cash flow
losers: coal miners if policy intervention compresses coal prices

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: By Dec26, consensus already expected 华能 to swing from 2021E EPS -0.10 to 2022E 0.45; shares had already experienced a massive 60d rerating before rolling over. 华电 offered a similar 2022 recovery at a far lower PE.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Tariff reform plus lower coal pressure makes the earnings repair more durable than a one-quarter rebound and can improve cash generation for renewable investment.
expectations.measurableGap: The gap is durability and cash repair, not merely a 2022 earnings rebound; the latter is already in consensus.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Turnaround earnings path plus peer-relative 2022E PE and prior price absorption.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: 2021E EPS -0.10 and 2022E EPS 0.45 for 华能 at 21.92x 2022E PE; 华电 2022E EPS 0.52 at 6.46x.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: The new tariff/fuel mechanism sustains profitability beyond the initial 2022 recovery and improves cash generation/renewable reinvestment.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: 华能 must recover faster or more durably than the cheaper thermal peers; merely meeting 2022 consensus is insufficient.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: 2022 recovery occurs but is fully anticipated and peer valuations remain more attractive.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Annual power contracts, coal prices and 2022 Q1 earnings can test the normalized spread within 60d.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: October tariff reform, coal-price intervention and company Q3 loss evidence establish a measurable spread-reset setup before cutoff; the magnitude of the 2022 recovery remains forecast rather than fully realized.
